name: Ruixinia
sum: Ruixinia is a somphospondylan sauropod from the Barremian Yixian Formation of China, with the most complete caudal series of any Asian titanosauriform.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted.
holotype: ELDM EL-J009, a partial articulated skeleton.
